meta.note: Default dog pet (golden retriever placeholder, v12 anim pack: 96x96, 12 tags / 70 frames; stylized short legs, matte brick-red collar, feathery tail). Behaviour states map to the 12 runtime clips: pat/rub -> pat_head, play -> stand_wag, bark/nudge/drag/land/sleep -> idle; ball_throw/ball_chase/paw_face/scratch/stand_wag/chase_tail/idle_blink render their own clips; ambient micro-actions cycle every 4-10s. Legacy tags listed in fallback resolve to the current clips. The 70 frame files contain 68 unique SHA-256 images: two cross-clip duplicates are declared in meta.duplicateFrames and kept as alias files (no redraw) so the frozen 70-frame pack contract and plugin embed indexes stay stable. v12 (2026-11-21 idle pass): 8-frame idle breathing/secondary motion, blink slowed to 8 fps (375ms).
